cases.sentence: Сын Давида Амнон влюбился в красавицу Фомарь, ___ Ависсалома.
cases.translation: The son of David, Amnon, fell in love with the beautiful Tamar, the sister of Absalom.
cases.explain: The preposition в (meaning motion toward) followed by the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Амнон так страдал из-за своей единокровной ___.
cases.translation: Amnon suffered so much because of his half-sister.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за (because of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Иоаннадав был друг Амнона, ___ Шиммы, брата Давида.
cases.translation: Jonadab was Amnon's friend, the son of Shimmah, the brother of David.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession; 'сын Шиммы' means 'Shimmah's son'.

cases.translation: He asked Amnon, 'Why, son of the king?'
cases.explain: The genitive shows possession; 'сын царя' means 'son of the king'.

cases.sentence: Пусть моя сестра Фомарь придет ко мне и даст мне чего-нибудь поесть у меня на ___.
cases.translation: Let my sister Tamar come to me and prepare food before my eyes.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on/before) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Tamar put her hands on her head.
cases.explain: The preposition за with the meaning 'grab' governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда царь пришел проведать своего сына, Амнон сказал ему о ___.
cases.translation: When the king came to see his son, Amnon spoke to him about his sister.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Давид послал во дворец приказ к ___.
cases.translation: David sent an order to his son.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) with direction toward a person takes the dative case.

reading.ru: Сын Давида Амнон влюбился в красавицу Фомарь, сестру Ависсалома, сына Давида.
reading.question: Who was Tamar and how was she related to Amnon?
options: She was the beautiful sister of Absalom, Amnon's brother
She was the daughter of the king
She was a servant in the palace
reading.correct: She was the beautiful sister of Absalom, Amnon's brother
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Amnon 'влюбился в красавицу Фомарь, сестру Ависсалома' — fell in love with the beautiful Tamar, the sister of Absalom.

reading.ru: Ложись в постель и притворись больным», — сказал Иоаннадав.
reading.question: What did Jonadab advise Amnon to do?
options: Pretend to be sick and lie in bed
Go visit Tamar in the palace
Ask the king for permission to marry Tamar
Leave the city for a while
reading.correct: Pretend to be sick and lie in bed
reading.explain: Jonadab told Amnon: 'Ложись в постель и притворись больным' — 'Lie down in bed and pretend to be sick.'

reading.ru: Давид послал во дворец сказать Фомаре, «Ступай в дом твоего брата Амнона и приготовь для него еду».
reading.question: What did King David command Tamar to do?
options: Go to her brother Amnon's house and prepare food for him
Stay in the palace and wait for Amnon
reading.correct: Go to her brother Amnon's house and prepare food for him
reading.explain: David sent word: 'Ступай в дом твоего брата Амнона и приготовь для него еду' — 'Go to your brother Amnon's house and prepare food for him.'

reading.ru: «Нет, брат», — сказала она ему, — «не принуждай меня. Нельзя творить в Израиле такого дела.»
reading.question: How did Tamar initially respond to Amnon's assault?
options: She refused and said such an act should not happen in Israel
She agreed to do as he asked
She called for help from the servants
She ran away from the house
reading.correct: She refused and said such an act should not happen in Israel
reading.explain: Tamar said: 'Нет, брат... нельзя творить в Израиле такого дела' — 'No, brother... such a thing should not happen in Israel.'

reading.ru: Ее брат Ависсалом сказал ей, «С тобой был твой брат Амнон? Но теперь, сестра, молчи.»
reading.question: What did Absalom tell Tamar after what happened?
options: To be quiet and not speak of it
To tell the king immediately what happened
To leave the house and never return
To go back to Amnon and forgive him
reading.correct: To be quiet and not speak of it

reading.ru: Два года спустя, когда у Ависсалома была стрижка овец в Баал-Хацоре, он пригласил туда всех царских сыновей.
reading.question: What event did Absalom organize two years later?
options: A sheep shearing festival where he invited all the king's sons
A religious ceremony at the temple
reading.correct: A sheep shearing festival where he invited all the king's sons
reading.explain: The text says: 'когда у Aviссалома была стрижка овец в Баал-Хацоре, он пригласил туда всех царских сыновей' — when Absalom had a sheep shearing at Baal Hazor, he invited all the king's sons.
